#### Project general facts
 
ELAR1S Rise is conceived as a sanctuary of balance, clarity, and understated luxury. Inspired by the Greek elements “Element” and “Aris” (air/hope), the project embodies the essence of air, light, and life. Its flowing architectural form creates an atmosphere of calm sophistication, offering residents a sense of openness and serenity that aligns with modern urban living. Every aspect of the development reinforces an elevated lifestyle centered on comfort, well-being, and natural harmony.

Designed for contemporary residents, ELAR1S Rise seamlessly blends sustainable design principles with timeless elegance. Spaces for living, working, and gathering coexist effortlessly within the building, creating a vibrant ecosystem where functionality meets thoughtful aesthetics. Premium views further amplify the project’s appeal, offering residents uninterrupted visual connections that enhance the feeling of space and tranquility.

An extensive suite of amenities supports a lifestyle of convenience, leisure, and social connection. Residents benefit from a clubhouse, outdoor lounge areas, a fully equipped gym, a kids’ playroom, a kids’ pool, and a main swimming pool with a pool deck and sun loungers. A welcoming lobby space and integrated smart home systems contribute to an elevated living experience, while the overall amenities program is designed to support wellness, community, and everyday comfort.

The residences are crafted to deliver modern quality and ease of living. Finishes follow a contemporary, high-standard approach, ensuring interiors feel both elegant and enduring. Each home features an equipped kitchen to support daily functionality, while the units are delivered unfurnished providing residents the freedom to tailor their living spaces to their personal style. Smart home and smart lock solutions further enhance convenience, aligning each residence with the expectations of modern, connected living.

#### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) is a thoughtfully master-planned residential district in Dubai that harmoniously combines tranquility with convenience. The community features a diverse mix of villas, townhouses, and apartments set amid lush landscaping and numerous parks. Its circular layout ensures intuitive navigation, while the extensive green areas offer a peaceful retreat for residents seeking a calm environment away from the city’s busy rhythm.

JVT provides a wide range of amenities suitable for both families and individuals. Within the neighborhood, residents have access to schools, supermarkets, healthcare facilities, and fitness centers, ensuring everyday essentials are close at hand. Abundant parks, jogging tracks, and cycling paths promote an active lifestyle, while the vibrant community center and retail outlets offer opportunities for shopping and social interaction. Its strategic proximity to major highways such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road ensures strong connectivity to major Dubai destinations, including Dubai Marina, JBR, and Downtown Dubai.

Designed to blend contemporary architecture with natural surroundings, JVT showcases well-planned infrastructure that prioritizes sustainability and livability. Water features and landscaped gardens enhance the charm of this serene residential area, making it a compelling option for those seeking modern conveniences in a green, tranquil setting. Whether you’re looking for a family-friendly community or a peaceful place to call home, JVT delivers an ideal balance of lifestyle and location.№
